ActorTalk: Only half of the F.O.S. Monument remains—one of Dominik's legacies aboard Babylonia.
And this small sculpture below shows what the F.O.S. Monument looked like when it was complete.
Most teachers and students didn't understand why Dominik insisted on bringing this monument aboard the starship at the time, but now it's clear that Dominik was right.
This half of the memorial has become a source of strength for many F.O.S. people.
